title: Par Health recalls 22 lots of IV blood thinner, its 3rd US product pull in a month
llm_note: Par Health is recalling 22 lots of intravenous argatroban due to contamination risks during manufacturing.

title: Kindeva lands $226M defense contract to supply nerve agent antidote in US
llm_note: Kindeva's Meridian unit secured a contract specifically to supply and manufacture nerve agent antidotes.

title: Galibra advances GAL-005 for SSADH deficiency
llm_note: Galibra contracted Genezen Laboratories to manufacture cGMP clinical material for its AAV-based gene therapy.
